value.rationale: Provides a complete infinite-family normal form over arbitrary characteristic-two fields, plus the exact even-finite-field number and every rank multiplicity. The sharp linear-in-n growth for fixed q and equally populated intermediate ranks expose structural properties of a natural maximal-nilindex chain that are not obtained from a single small example. Relevance is intrinsic to Rota–Baxter operators and potential perturbation baselines; no unproved downstream application is asserted.
